title: PROJECTOR
rule: one frame, eight pieces of work: the frame never moves, the log scrolls beside it and decides what the frame shows
description: Eight pieces of work as a log of eight rows, beside one fixed frame. It opens on a live product (Bayyinah TV: members subscribe on the web, iPhone or Android, with the ring on the free-trial button) and then the strongest result (one billing report: 16 requests to the database and a timeout, now 2). The row at the reading line is the current one; the frame shows its screen, and a hairline runs from the row's result into the frame to the part that proves it.
signature: Big Shoulders Display for the row numerals, the report diagram and the store panel; Public Sans for text; ink #141B06 on a chartreuse field #D9F26B (14.2:1; muted #3E4A14 at 7.7:1). Both faces are preloaded by the page; text never waits for them. Identity: 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps that people subscribe to, shop in and read with.' then '5+ years. Part of two platform rewrites. Based in Kosovo, working remotely.' Desktop: a 440 px log at the left with the identity line at its top; an 880 x 676 frame at the right, sticky, with one caption line under it, set in the middle of the viewport. Rows: 01 Bayyinah TV pricing page (ring on Start 7-Day Free Trial; phone crop rings 'Watch anytime, anywhere, on mobile, tablet or desktop'); 02 the 16 -> 2 report diagram; 03 care card recreation (ring on the organization switch); 04 Viva Fresh, 07 Read to Feed (public store screen, ring on the book card with 'Read 36%', archived store links) and 08 Dukagjini Bookstore as iPhone screens at source pixels with a store panel; 05 Design System v2 as four cards of the set (buttons, fields, switches, alerts; no token names; inert); 06 Incentiv sign-in. Current row has three signals: the plate, the result band and the hairline with its ring (no numeral fill, no tray, no second index on phone). Motion: the first screenshot fades in 200 ms, then the hairline draws in 180 ms to its ring. A row becomes current after it settles at 42% of the viewport for 160 ms; the plate cross-fades in 200 ms, the result band wipes in (clip-path, 240 ms), the old line fades (120 ms) and the new one draws (180 ms). Keyboard moves (arrows, Home, End) jump with no animation. Phone: the frame pins at the top at 4:3; crops grow inside their own screen bounds and are never shown above source pixels; the ring alone marks the proof. Reduced motion: no fade, no wipe, no draw.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. A sticky frame beside a scrolling numbered log is a known scrollytelling layout (pudding.cool); the report diagram and the store panel are new, the frame is not. Other limits after pass 8b: the store screens (rows 04, 07, 08) are @3x captures at source pixels, so they read larger than a real phone; the Design System v2 board is centred with about 80 px of its own ground above and below; at 1024 px the row 01 result band takes two lines (the critic asked for one; the result needs about 480 px and the column is 301 px); the 16 -> 2 'Now' lane keeps empty width beside its two cells, which is the point of the figure; the line jumps once if the faces arrive after 300 ms (measured CLS 0.0006 with fonts 2.5 s late).
